kane.one_liner: completed a 10 USDC swap on SafuSwap
kane.summary:
Connected the wallet and confirmed the connection request.
Set the payment amount to 10 USDC and started the swap.
Reviewed the SafuWallet confirmation details: the action was Swap and the amount was exactly 10 USDC.
The confirmation details matched the requested swap, and the swap was completed.
